scenes.label: Forest, midday
scenes.description: Soft canopy wind, scattered birds at distance, a slow creek behind it all.

scenes.label: Forest, night
scenes.description: Wind through dark canopy, a slow creek behind it. No birds.

scenes.label: Rain on the window

scenes.label: Fireplace
scenes.description: Slow wood fire close at hand, a distant room-mic crackle behind it.
